exercices.title: Memory Exercices
exercices.subtitle: Train your memory to help manage epilepsy

1.title: Memory Sequence
1.subtitle: Repeat the sequence of colors
1.explanations:
Memorize the sequence I gave you. Then click on the colored buttons to let us know if you remembered it correctly.
Click 'Start' to play!
1.message1new: Memorize the new color sequence requested
1.messageWrong: Wrong sequence ❌ . You can see the number of successful sequences in the bottom right corner. Press Start again to restart if you want.

2.title: Visual Pattern
2.subtitle: Remember the highlited quares
2.explanations:
Remember which squares in the grid are highlighted. Then click on the squares to tell us which ones you think were highlighted.
Click 'Start' to play!
2.message1: Saves the sequence of highlighted cells
2.message1new: Save the new sequence of highlighted cells
2.messageWrong: Wrong sequence ❌ . You can see the number of successful sequences in the bottom right corner. Press Start again to restart if you want.

3.title: Common Name
3.subtitle: Find a common name based on a definition
3.explanations:
Given a definition of a word, find the word. Of course, you know the first letter of the word you're looking for. You have 3 lives to find 5 words that start with this letter.
Choose a 'Letter' to play ! *
3.message2: *Of course, the game will only include a few examples. Thanks to the AI, there will always be more. If you're interested in trying it out, sign up for early access.

4.title: Quick Brain
4.subtitle: Find words quickly
4.explanations:
Choose the correct answer based on the question asked. There are several levels, and you have a limited amount of time to answer. Good luck.
Click ‘Start’ to play ! *
4.message2: *Of course, the game will only include a few examples. Thanks to the AI, there will always be more. If you're interested in trying it out, sign up for early access.
4.messageWrong: Wrong sequence ❌ . You can see the number of successful sequences in the bottom right corner. Press Start again to restart if you want.

5.title: Pattern Builder
5.subtitle: Reproduce a specified pattern
5.explanations:
Memorize the colored squares. Then click on the squares to tell us which ones you think are colored. Good luck.
Click ‘Start’ to play ! *
5.messageWrong: Wrong sequence ❌ . You can see the number of successful sequences in the bottom right corner. Press Start again to restart if you want.

6.title: N-Back Training
6.subtitle: Improve working memory
6.explanations:
Mémorise les cases colorées. Then click the “Same” or “Other” boxes to let us know if the same ones were colored
Click 'Start' to play !
6.messageEnd:
End Game !
You can see the number of successful sequences in the bottom right corner.
Press Start again to restart if you want.

7.title: Scattergories
7.subtitle: Find different names that start with the chosen letter and end with the same letters
7.message2: *Of course, the game will only have a few examples for now, and you’ll be able to access the four easiest letters. There will, of course, be more added over time thanks to the AI. If you’re interested in accessing them, sign up to get early access.
7.explanations:
Choose a letter. This letter corresponds to the first letter of the word you're looking for. All words starting with the chosen letter will end with the same letters. You have 3 lives to find 5 words.
Choose your ‘Letter’ to play! *
